EDSA Bus Carousel⁣ to Remain,Says DOTr The Department of Transportation (DOTr) has announced that the EDSA bus carousel will not be removed,despite calls for its dismantling. This decision comes as part of broader efforts ⁣to streamline public transportation ‌in Metro Manila.

The DOTr’s decision to retain the EDSA bus carousel is part of a larger strategy to improve public transportation in the bustling metropolis. The bus carousel system, which allows buses to pick ​up and drop off passengers in ⁢a designated area, has been a contentious issue among ​commuters and business groups alike.
Business Group Warnings
Several business groups have expressed concerns over the potential removal of ⁣the EDSA bus lane. According to a​ report by‍ GMA News Online, these groups argue that the ⁣bus lane is crucial for maintaining efficient public‌ transportation. The removal of the lane coudl lead to increased traffic⁣ congestion and longer commute times, which‍ would⁤ negatively impact‌ both ⁤businesses and⁣ commuters.
DOTr’s Vision for 2026
The DOTr has outlined plans to privatize the bus system by 2026. This move is aimed at enhancing the efficiency and reliability of public transportation. According to ABS-CBN, the privatization plan ⁣includes modernizing the ⁣bus fleet and improving infrastructure to better serve commuters. MMDA’s Anti-Commuter ‍Plans
Meanwhile, the ⁢Metropolitan manila development Authority (MMDA) has proposed option⁣ measures to address traffic congestion. Inquirer.net‌ reported that the MMDA ‍is considering various anti-commuter plans,including the optimization of the Mabuhay Lanes.​ These ‌lanes are designed to facilitate the smooth flow of traffic, particularly during peak hours.
Public​ Reaction and Futures
The decision to retain ‍the⁢ EDSA​ bus carousel has sparked mixed reactions among the public. While some commuters welcome the move, others remain skeptical about the long-term⁤ benefits. The DOTr’s commitment to privatization and modernization offers​ a glimmer of hope for ​improved public transportation, but only ‍time will tell if these plans will materialize.
Conclusion The DOTr’s announcement ⁣to retain ⁤the EDSA bus carousel is a meaningful step⁢ in the ongoing efforts to enhance public transportation in Metro Manila. As the city continues to grapple with traffic congestion,⁤ the balance between maintaining existing infrastructure and implementing new solutions will be crucial. The future ⁣of the EDSA⁢ bus system remains a topic of interest, and all eyes are on the ​DOTr’s plans for privatization and modernization.
